label: À La Carte
title: Dining Room
description: Urban Hearth is designed for those who love to dine well. The room is intimate, lively, and comfortable, with a quiet sense of luxury that invites guests to linger — over another glass of wine, another course, another conversation. Warm and gracious hospitality creates an experience that feels refined and easy whether you are celebrating a milestone or the end of a busy day.

The à la carte menu, available in the dining room, bar, and salon, follows the seasons. Rooted in locally sourced ingredients and informed by culinary traditions from around the world, the menu changes as ingredients come into season and new ideas emerge.

We approach our beverage program with the same care and curiosity that guide our kitchen. The wine list features both celebrated producers and emerging voices, with an emphasis on character, place, and balance. Seasonal cocktails showcase exceptional spirits and house-made ingredients, alongside a broad selection of beer, cider, and non-alcoholic beverages.

label: Chef's Tasting Menu
title: Chef's Counter
description: An intimate front-row seat to the creative heart of Urban Hearth.

Join us at our six-seat Chef’s Counter for an immersive tasting menu featuring 8–12 courses inspired by the season, the farm, and the larder. Watch the kitchen at work, engage directly with the chefs, and experience each dish as it is finished and presented.

Led by James Beard Award-nominated Chef Erin Miller, the menu showcases exceptional local ingredients, foraged discoveries, and refined technique in a setting that is equal parts dinner party and culinary performance.
Thoughtful hospitality, lively conversation, and unforgettable food come together in an experience designed to delight and nourish.

The Chef’s Counter experience is available Tuesday through Saturday at 5:30 and 8:00 pm. We offer an omnivore or vegetarian menu. Limited accommodation is made for allergies and dietary needs. Please note requests in your reservation.
priceSuffix: per person, plus tax and tip

label: Bar & Salon
title: Bar & Salon
description: Natural wines, craft cocktails, and small plates in a relaxed room that keeps its own hours. Walk-ins always welcome; reservations recommended for groups of four or more.
The salon is available for private gatherings. To book, reach out to our concierge team at concierge@urbanhearth.net.
